title: Many compiler diagnostics print a `rule:` id or the word "refused" in their help text.
text: `E0234`, `E0413`, `E0448` and `E0230` are among them. A diagnostic is product text, held to AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*, which has no rule ids and says "is not allowed" or "does not compile" for a refusal. That section binds a diagnostic when it is written or changed, so these stay until something rewrites them. It closes when no diagnostic's message or help prints a `rule:` id or a form of "refuse", with a test that scans the help texts.
